adminCookie.name: kmits_session
adminCookie.description: Opaque 24-hour website session. HTTPS deployments use __Host-kmits_session instead. Mutations also require Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

appsScriptBearer.description: Server-side APPS_SCRIPT_INGESTION_SECRET, 32+ characters. Independent of admin login. Never send this from public browser code.
